definitions.explanation: A facility where aircraft take off and land, with terminals for passengers.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{空港|くうこう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{送|おく}ります→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll take you to the airport.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time will you arrive at the airport?

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for a friend at the airport.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{出|で}なければなりません→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The airport is far from my house, so I have to leave early.

notes:
{空港|くうこう} combines {空|そら} (sky) and {港|みなと} (port) to mean "airport."

MAJOR JAPANESE AIRPORTS:
- {成田|なりた}{空港|くうこう}: Narita Airport (Tokyo international)
- {羽田|はねだ}{空港|くうこう}: Haneda Airport (Tokyo domestic/international)
- {関西|かんさい}{国際|こくさい}{空港|くうこう}: Kansai International Airport
- {新千歳|しんちとせ}{空港|くうこう}: New Chitose Airport (Sapporo)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {空港|くうこう}に{着|つ}く: to arrive at the airport
- {空港|くうこう}まで{送|おく}る: to take someone to the airport
- {空港|くうこう}で{出迎|でむか}える: to meet at the airport
- {国際|こくさい}{空港|くうこう}: international airport
- {国内|こくない}{線|せん}: domestic flights

TRAVEL VOCABULARY:
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}ロビー: departure lobby
- {到着|とうちゃく}ロビー: arrival lobby
- {搭乗|とうじょう}{口|ぐち}: boarding gate
